start.title: Under the Palm of Deborah
start.text:
Israel comes to you for judgment.
The Lord's word burns in your heart.

choices.text: Listen and judge with His wisdom

choices.feedback: Lean not on your own mind.

ignore_consequence.title: They Still Come
ignore_consequence.text:
His call cannot be silenced.
Return to your seat of judgment.

choices.text: Listen and judge with His wisdom

self_consequence.title: Not Your Wisdom
self_consequence.text:
His Spirit must speak through you.
Quiet your heart and listen.

choices.text: Listen and judge with His wisdom

call_barak.title: The Lord's Command
call_barak.text:
Sisera oppresses Israel with iron.
The Lord names Barak as captain.

choices.text: Summon Barak to receive the word

lead_consequence.title: His Order, Not Yours
lead_consequence.text:
The Lord has chosen Barak.
Obey the calling He has given.

choices.text: Summon Barak to receive the word

barak_arrives.title: Barak Hesitates
barak_arrives.text:
"I will go only if you go."
His faith leans on your presence.

choices.feedback: Lift him; do not crush him.

refuse_consequence.title: Strengthen His Hand
refuse_consequence.text:
Faith grows when leaders walk together.
Go with him to the battle.

mock_consequence.title: Lead, Do Not Wound
mock_consequence.text:
Your presence is His gift to him.
Walk beside, not above.

march_to_tabor.title: Ten Thousand on Tabor
march_to_tabor.text:
Sisera's chariots gather below.
The army watches you for a sign.

choices.text: Wait for better odds and weapons
Declare the Lord goes before you

wait_consequence.title: Now Is the Hour
wait_consequence.text:
He has delivered them already.
Lift the banner and descend.

choices.text: Declare the Lord goes before you

battle_kishon.title: Down Into the Plain
battle_kishon.text:
Storm clouds darken the river.
Chariots sink in the rising mud.

choices.text: Charge in the strength He gives

choices.feedback: His enemy will not be reasoned with.

hold_consequence.title: Iron Cannot Stand Today
hold_consequence.text:
The Lord has shaken their wheels.
Do not waste His mercy.

choices.text: Charge in the strength He gives

negotiate_consequence.title: No Truce With Tyranny
negotiate_consequence.text:
Sisera will not free His people.
The Lord has handed him over.

choices.text: Charge in the strength He gives
choices.feedback: You raise your hand and call.

victory.title: Sisera's Army Falls
victory.text:
Not one chariot remains standing.
Israel breathes free again.

credit_consequence.title: His Glory Alone
credit_consequence.text:
No sword of yours broke them.
Lift His name above your own.

choices.feedback: You bow your head in song.

ending_faithful.title: The Land Has Rest
ending_faithful.text:
Forty years of peace will follow.
Faith led where fear could not.
